List each matching path **relative to `test-repo/`** (i.e., starting with `packages/`), one per line, sorted alphabetically. The answer must be an exact, complete list — no extra paths, no omissions.

Expected answer format: a list of relative file paths (relative to `test-repo/`), one per line, sorted alphabetically (standard lexicographic order on the full path string).
